**1 — Scene:** A cafeteria-style plate of chicken and mixed vegetables in a glossy brown sauce, apparently served with rice. I’m estimating the large plate on the right only; the fruit, drinks, and other plates are excluded.

**2 — Vessel:** Approximately 26 cm diameter, with an area of 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Rice, chicken pieces, mixed vegetables (peppers, carrots, and onion), and brown sauce. Any cooking oil is included in the sauce’s energy estimate.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:** Areas are apportioned between ingredients to avoid counting overlapping food twice.

| Item | Plate area | Typical height | Gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked rice | 20% = 106 cm² | 1.6 cm | 170 ml | 0.8 | 136 g | 130 | 177 kcal |
| Chicken pieces | 25% = 133 cm² | 1.5 cm | 199 ml | 0.95 | 189 g | 175 | 331 kcal |
| Mixed vegetables | 25% = 133 cm² | 1.6 cm | 212 ml | 0.6 | 127 g | 40 | 51 kcal |
| Brown sauce, including oil | 8% = 42 cm² | 0.5 cm | 21 ml | 1.0 | 21 g | 160 | 34 kcal |

**8 — Sanity check:** The allocated areas total **78%** of the plate, consistent with the substantial uncovered rim. Approximately **473 g and 593 kcal** is plausible for the visible mound. Identification of the rice and the sauce’s oil content are the main uncertainties.
